description: STC-07's Fill.1 (#118): a SHELL_BASED_SURFACE_MODEL of a one-face OPEN_SHELL — CATIA's Fill surface — in inches, read as a one-face sheet body (ADR-0057), held to Open CASCADE's surface properties of the same shell. Excerpted by tools/oracle/excerpt.py. Open CASCADE's healed face is 1.6e-7 (relative) off the planar triangle of its three vertices, whose area is 0.5·|(B−A)×(C−A)| = 7.7961613602 mm² and which Arris matches to 2e-12: the fixture's area and inertia tolerances are widened to 5e-7 for that reason (docs/adr/0057)
